answer: A river of new identities is only dangerous if each drop costs nothing. Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that returns slowly, so a flood of fake accounts must pay for each one. Let honest attestations ripple outward: each vouch ties the voucher's own stake to the claim, so a bad endorsement burns the endorser too. A gale of sockpuppets then faces real cost per identity and a public ledger where one lie taints the whole cluster — cheap to join, expensive to fake at scale.
